title: Career Roadmap · Boilermaker
summary: A Boilermaker fabricates, assembles, repairs and maintains boilers, pressure vessels, tanks and heavy metal structures used in power generation and industrial processing.

blocks.text: Primary pathway
Core work
Engineering drawings • Plate forming • Welding and fit-up • Pressure-vessel assembly • Inspection support • Repair and maintenance.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science; check the chosen trade's entry criteria.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science in Classes 11–12 is useful but not always required for an ITI pathway.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: State ITI counselling or institute-specific admission.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Welding, plate fabrication, pipe fitting, mechanical drawings and industrial safety.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Measurement, geometry, material identification, technical drawing and safe workshop practice.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Workshop safety, engineering drawings, metal identification and measurement.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Fabrication
blocks.text: Plate marking, cutting, rolling, bending, fitting and welding.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Pressure-vessel drawings, joint preparation, dimensional inspection and quality documentation.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Supervised industrial practice, apprenticeship applications and trade assessments.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Fabricate a small plate assembly • Build a cylindrical tank model (non-pressurized) • Prepare a boiler-component drawing • Assemble a practice flange-and-pipe section.
Pressure equipment must only be manufactured, tested or repaired under qualified supervision and applicable safety regulations.

blocks.label: Government / public sector
blocks.text: Eligible railway workshops, power-sector facilities, defence manufacturing units and public-sector engineering companies.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Boiler manufacturers, pressure-vessel fabricators, power plants, refineries, shipyards and heavy-engineering firms.

blocks.label: Ideal training areas
blocks.text: Plate fabrication • Boiler assembly • Welding and fit-up • Industrial maintenance • Quality inspection.
Search Apprenticeship India. Availability, stipend and eligibility depend on the employer and official notification.

blocks.label: Further education
blocks.text: Eligible Mechanical Engineering diploma → Fabrication, production, maintenance or quality roles.

blocks.label: Important distinction
blocks.text: A Boilermaker fabricates or repairs equipment. A Boiler Operator / Boiler Attendant operates boiler systems and may require separate statutory certification under applicable rules.
Relevant programs

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Boiler fabrication • Pressure vessels • Plate rolling • Industrial welding • Boiler maintenance • Quality inspection.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Power generation, heavy engineering, refineries, chemicals, shipbuilding, manufacturing and industrial utilities.

blocks.label: Technical skills
blocks.text: Plate layout, metal forming, welding, fit-up, engineering drawing interpretation, measurement, defect awareness and safe working practices.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Cutting equipment, plate rollers, welding machines, grinders, measuring tools and fabrication drawings.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized certificate in a relevant ITI trade.
Additional inspection or quality training for relevant roles.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Canada, Australia, UK and New Zealand.

blocks.label: Training routes
blocks.text: Recognized vocational colleges and technical institutes offering welding, metal fabrication, mechanical engineering or industrial maintenance.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Relevant education or trade experience, practical assessment where applicable, language proficiency and study documentation. Course availability and qualification recognition vary.

blocks.label: Potential roles
blocks.text: Boilermaker, Boiler Fabricator, Pressure-Vessel Fabricator, Industrial Welder and Mechanical Maintenance Technician.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Energy, heavy manufacturing, shipbuilding, mining, chemical processing and industrial maintenance.
Local licensing, work authorization and employer requirements vary. Overseas employment or visa sponsorship is not guaranteed.
